newsitem.title: USA: Williams Cos in Calif. crude oil venture.
newsitem.headline: Williams Cos in Calif. crude oil venture.

text.p: Williams Cos Inc said Tuesday one of its units has formed a limited liability company with Mid-Kern Energy Marketing Co Inc to market crude oil in California.
Mid-Kern is a petroleum marketing company based in Bakersfield, Calif.

The new entity, Rio Bravo Energy Marketing LLC, will focus its business in Kern and Los Angeles counties, providing transportation services to oil producers and developing crude supply for refiners, Williams Cos said.
Williams Cos spokesman Steve Hill said the amount of the investment in the venture was not disclosed, but operating profits from it would be divided evenly.
